task_title: Merge train wake-up gaps: always()-dispatch and schedule wake

plan_review.notes: No blocking concerns. Verdict convergent with the two implemented fixes; two non-blocking suggestions (non-CI workflow_run pass-through test, wake-step ordering test) incorporated.
plan_review.summary: Reviewed the two-gap plan: if always on the wake dispatch step; schedule/MERGE_TRAIN_ENABLED carve-out mirroring ci-recovery-incidents.yml on the reconcile job guard. Verdict: no blocking concerns, convergent with reviewer own design. Two non-blocking test-coverage suggestions (non-CI workflow_run pass-through, wake-step ordering) were incorporated as new tests.

rounds.summary: No significant issues. Verified YAML precedence/semantics of the schedule carve-out, storm-guard non-regression, safety of if: always() on the wake step (permissions present, desirable behavior when publish job is malformed/cancelled), and correctness of the evaluatesReconcileCondition test-helper substitution approach.

Round 2: reviewed a follow-up delta responding to a copilot-pull-request-reviewer bot finding on an autonomous agent-merge commit -- the retryable-check fallback step reused the original (possibly-failed) app-token output. Added a dedicated recovery-app-token mint step (if: failure()) and rewired the fallback step to use it. Verified if: failure() semantics are job-scoped (fires correctly even if the original app-token mint step is what failed), confirmed graceful degradation if the recovery mint also fails (wake dispatch still fires via if: always() with GITHUB_TOKEN, falling back to the pre-existing staleness bound), confirmed complete test coverage (token reference, step existence/ordering/condition), and found no permission/cost/syntax issues. No significant issues found.

Round 3: reviewed the bounded retry added to the recovery check publication. Verified exactly three attempts, immediate first attempt, 1-second and 2-second waits, early return on success, final-error propagation after exhaustion, and executable parsed-workflow coverage proving third-attempt success. No significant issues found.
